title: Citi Forecasts Widening Memory Chip Shortages Through 2031 as AI Demand Expands
summary: Citi expects shortages across the global memory semiconductor market to deepen through 2031, driven by increasing demand for high-bandwidth memory (HBM), DRAM and NAND as artificial intelligence systems adopt continual learning. In a research note published Monday, the investment bank identified continual learning as a potential central theme in AI development over the next five years.
